quests.title: Bait Resupply Plan

dialogue.sit: I ran out of Glowgrass Bait.

dialogue.t: Huh? Good thing you brought enough materials last time, I made some spares.
Come on, take these. If you run out again, you know where to find me.

quests.description: You’re out of Glowgrass Bait. Time to find Kujirai Momiji to make some more…
